pre_condition: proj_dir is a path to an existing directory.
post_condition: Returns (funcs, langs). funcs is a dict mapping each absolute file path to a non-empty list of (func_name, body_text) tuples for all functions extractable from that file across all supported languages. langs is a set of language key strings, containing exactly those language keys for which at least one function was extracted. When no function is extractable from any file in proj_dir, returns ({}, set()).
